role: ordinary learned goal-classification control and engineering pilot; not a novel paper method
feature: concat of frozen DUET global and local cross-modal STOP embeddings, 1536 dimensions; includes every actual decision state
target: training-only graph distance from observed current node to annotated goal < 3 metres
label_scope: R2R success-region membership; not a full instruction-completion label
loss: BCE mean over states within each episode, then mean over episodes; no class reweighting
checkpoint_monitor: train_dev episode-weighted BCE, explicitly a diagnostic checkpoint, not best navigation checkpoint
policy: keep baseline movement actions and online STOP; rank observed historical endpoints by the probe logit at termination; include complete return path in evaluation
mandatory_gates: exact three-branch logit parity when replaying every cached source state
train/dev provenance equality and disjoint houses
nonzero positive and negative labels, plus per-house support reported
unchanged movement/online termination verified before attributing endpoint differences
registered full official validation access before any such evaluation
interpretation: Small D1 sample only checks feasibility of the ordinary goal head. It cannot establish the later paired-data hypothesis or full-data negative results.
persistence: per-episode feature cache and full optimizer/RNG training checkpoints backed up to mounted Drive with SHA readback before local checkpoint pruning
